It gives the proposed $2,356 a seat, says Dana passed it on and you OK'd sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it internal because it isn't a signed term. Nothing has gone out yet: it's sitting as a draft for you to send. I've told you the same in your DM with me.

I didn't file a separate approval request. Hollis doesn't own the Quarrendon account (Dana does), so per-seat rates normally need sign-off from you or June before they go to him. Your message counts as that sign-off. The address is on pemberline.com, so Ruth didn't need to approve it.
